instructions: Lawmatics is a legal CRM and client intake platform. Responses use JSON:API format with { data, meta, links } envelopes. Pagination info is in the meta field (total_pages, limit_per_page, total_entries). All list tools support: page, sort_order (asc/desc), sort_by, filter_by, filter_on, filter_with (=, !=, like, etc.). Use page to paginate and filter_by/filter_on/filter_with to narrow results.
